sources.label: Morphe android app patches (for apps that I use) - stable releases
sources.author: bearinmind
patch_list: Never learns from what you type.
Renames Samsung Keyboard, so the two keyboards can be told apart.
Installs next to the system Samsung Keyboard under its own package name.
Turns off Samsung Analytics, crash reports and typed-text collection.
Stops GIPHY and Tenor view and share pings.
Keeps the keyboard offline. GIFs, stickers, translation, AI tools and language downloads stop working.
Ignores keyboard policies pushed from Samsung's servers.
